title: రామాయణం · బాలకాండ మొదటి భాగం: వాల్మీకి తొలి శ్లోకం నుంచి రాముడి తొలి యుద్ధం వరకు
topic: బాలకాండ మొదటి భాగం (వాల్మీకి రామాయణం 1.1–1.30, ముగింపు 1.31 నుంచి): నారదుడికి వాల్మీకి ప్రశ్న, క్రౌంచ పక్షులు, తొలి శ్లోకం, బ్రహ్మ ఆదేశం; అయోధ్య, యాగం, నలుగురు రాకుమారులు; విశ్వామిత్రుడు రాముడిని అడగడం; తాటక, దివ్యాస్త్రాలు; ఆరు రోజుల యాగ రక్షణ
edition: vulgate (southern recension), sa.wikisource; verse numbers cross-checked on valmikiramayan.net (Internet Archive copy) where noted

scenes.narration: రాముడు చిన్నవాడని తండ్రి భయపడ్డారు. ఆరో రోజు, రాక్షసులు రానే వచ్చారు.
scenes.visual: night at a forest hermitage, a square red-brick fire altar at the left third of the frame with a tall blazing fire, its saffron and gold flames leaping upward on open dark board, {rama_teen} with exactly two arms standing to the right of the fire in three-quarter back view with his face turned away and hidden from the viewer, head tilted up toward the sky, his bow held upright in his left hand clear of his body, {lakshmana_teen} with exactly two arms standing a few paces further right in side view facing left, head tilted up, his bow held clear of his body, a wide gap of open board between the fire and Rama and between the two princes, dark monsoon storm clouds massing across the upper right with a band of open board between the clouds and the princes' heads, small thatched huts as dark shapes far behind, horizon line one third from the top, the lower fifth of the frame plain dark chalkboard

scenes.narration: ఆరు రాత్రింబవళ్లు నిద్ర మాని అన్నదమ్ములు యజ్ఞాగ్నిని కాపాడారు. ఇప్పుడు వానమబ్బుల్లా రాక్షసులు వేదికపై విరుచుకుపడ్డారు.
scenes.visual: low wide view from behind a square red-brick fire altar, a small fire burning at the lower left with open board around its flames, two huge shadow rakshasas diving out of dark monsoon clouds at the upper right, {maricha} and further right {subahu}, each with both arms stretched forward and wild hair streaming back, a wide gap of open board between the two silhouettes, {rama_teen} with exactly two arms and {lakshmana_teen} with exactly two arms small in the lower centre, both in three-quarter back view facing the sky, standing well apart with bows raised, jagged white chalk lightning between the clouds, horizon line one third from the top, the lower fifth of the frame plain dark chalkboard

scenes.narration: అయితే తండ్రి భయపడిన ఆ బాలుడి చేతిలో, దేవతలకైనా దుర్లభమైన దివ్యాస్త్రాలు ఉన్నాయి.
scenes.visual: medium wide shot, {rama_teen} with exactly two arms drawn large at the left third of the frame in three-quarter back view with his face turned away and hidden from the viewer, facing right and drawing his bow at full stretch, the bow held out at arm's length in his left hand, his right elbow drawn back and raised clear of his body and hair against open dark board, a faint golden glow gathering at the arrowhead, a square red-brick altar fire glowing small on open board at the far right, a wide band of open board between the arrow tip and the fire, horizon line one third from the top, the lower fifth of the frame plain dark chalkboard

scenes.narration: కానీ ఈ కథ అంతకు ఎంతో ముందే, ప్రశాంతమైన నది ఒడ్డున, ఒక కవితో, ఒక ప్రశ్నతో, రెండు పక్షులతో మొదలవుతుంది.
scenes.visual: calm wide river landscape at dawn, the whole upper half of the frame left as plain open dark chalkboard for the title, a quiet river curving across the lower middle of the frame, a clump of tall reeds standing on open board on the right bank, {krauncha_pair} small at the left third on the near bank with open board around their necks and heads, a soft pale dawn glow low along the horizon just below the middle of the frame, the lower fifth of the frame plain dark chalkboard

scenes.narration: ఎంతో కాలం క్రితం, వాల్మీకి మహర్షి, మాటలలో మేటి అయిన నారదుడిని ఒక ప్రశ్న అడిగారు.
scenes.visual: a quiet forest hermitage clearing in morning light, {valmiki} with exactly two arms seated cross-legged on a low flat rock at the left third of the frame in three-quarter view facing right, his right hand raised beside his shoulder with the palm open in a questioning gesture, held clear of his beard and body against open board, his left hand resting on his knee, {narada} with exactly two arms standing at the right third in side view facing left, his veena held upright in his left hand beside him and clear of his body, a wide gap of open board between the two sages, a small thatched hut far behind on the left and a single tree far behind on the right, horizon line one third from the top, the lower fifth of the frame plain dark chalkboard

scenes.narration: ఈ లోకంలో గుణవంతుడు, వీరుడు, ధర్మజ్ఞుడు, సత్యవాక్కు, కోపాన్ని జయించినవాడు, యుద్ధంలో దేవతలే భయపడేవాడు ఎవరైనా ఉన్నారా?
scenes.visual: the verse written in chalk on the open dark board, wide horizontal layout

scenes.narration: నారదుడు సంతోషించారు. ఇన్ని గుణాలు అరుదు, కానీ ఇక్ష్వాకు వంశంలో పుట్టిన రాముడు అనే ఒక్కడిలో అవన్నీ ఉన్నాయి అన్నారు.
scenes.visual: a forest hermitage clearing, {narada} with exactly two arms standing at the right third of the frame in three-quarter view facing left, smiling, his right arm extended forward and upward with the open palm turned toward the left, the arm held clear of his body against open board above the level of Valmiki's head, his veena held upright in his left hand clear of his body, {valmiki} with exactly two arms seated cross-legged in the centre in three-quarter view facing Narada, listening with his hands resting on his knees, at the left third high on open board a faint glowing outline of {rama_teaser} drawn in soft golden chalk light like a vision, wide open board between all three figures, horizon line one third from the top, the lower fifth of the frame plain dark chalkboard

scenes.narration: కథంతా చెప్పి నారదుడు ఆకాశంలోకి వెళ్లిపోయారు. తర్వాత తమసా తీరాన, ఒకదాన్నొకటి విడువకుండా తియ్యగా కూస్తున్న క్రౌంచ పక్షుల జంటను వాల్మీకి చూశారు.
scenes.visual: a wide river bank in morning light, the Tamasa river flowing across the lower middle of the frame, {valmiki} with exactly two arms standing at the right third in side view facing left, gazing at the birds, his hands held a little away from his body, {bharadvaja} small a few paces behind him further right with open board between them, at the left third {krauncha_pair} standing close together on the bank with their long necks raised in song against open board, high in the upper right {narada} very small rising into the sky on a faint trail of light with open board all around him, horizon line one third from the top, the lower fifth of the frame plain dark chalkboard

scenes.narration: అంతలోనే ఆయన కళ్ల ముందే, పాపపు మనసున్న వేటగాడు మగ పక్షిని కూల్చాడు. నేలపై పడిన తోడును చూసి ఆడపక్షి దీనంగా విలపించింది.
scenes.visual: a riverbank among reeds, {valmiki} with exactly two arms standing at the left third of the frame in side view facing right, his right arm raised and stretched out toward the birds with the palm open, held clear of his body and beard against open board, his left hand pressed to his chest, in the centre of the frame on the open bank a female krauncha crane with her long neck stretched straight up toward the sky, beak open, crying, open board all around her neck and head, beside her a male crane lying still on the ground with wings folded, drawn gently and whole, far at the right edge a small dark silhouette of a hunter with a lowered bow half hidden among trees, wide open board between Valmiki, the birds and the hunter, horizon line one third from the top, the lower fifth of the frame plain dark chalkboard

scenes.narration: మహర్షి మనసు జాలితో కరిగి, నోట అప్రయత్నంగా మాటలు వెలువడ్డాయి: ఓ వేటగాడా, ప్రేమలో ఉన్న జంటలో ఒకదాన్ని చంపావు, నీకు ఎన్నటికీ ప్రతిష్ఠ దక్కకుండు గాక.
scenes.visual: the verse written in chalk on the open dark board, wide horizontal layout

scenes.narration: తన మాటలకు తానే ఆశ్చర్యపోతూ, అవి నాలుగు పాదాలుగా పాడేందుకు తగినట్టు వచ్చాయని గమనించి, శోకం నుంచి పుట్టింది కాబట్టి ఇది శ్లోకం అన్నారు.
scenes.visual: medium wide shot at the river's edge, {valmiki} with exactly two arms standing at the left third of the frame in three-quarter view facing right, one hand at his chest and the other held open beside him, clear of his body, gazing in wonder at the open board on the right where four even horizontal lines of soft golden chalk light hang in the air, {bharadvaja} small further back on the left, listening, with open board between him and the sage, the river flowing across the lower middle, horizon line one third from the top, the lower fifth of the frame plain dark chalkboard

scenes.narration: తర్వాత బ్రహ్మదేవుడు వచ్చి, నా సంకల్పంతోనే ఈ వాక్కు పుట్టింది, రాముడి కథంతా చెప్పు, కొండలూ నదులూ ఉన్నంత కాలం అది నిలుస్తుంది అన్నారు. అలా మహర్షి శోకం శ్లోకమైంది, ఆ శ్లోకమే రామాయణమైంది.
scenes.visual: a wide landscape, snowy mountain peaks low along the horizon one third from the top, a long river winding across the frame toward the viewer, {brahma_light} hovering at the right third in the open sky, {valmiki} with exactly two arms standing at the lower left third in side view facing right, palms joined in front of his chest and held a little away from his body, faint lines of chalk verse drifting from him in a gentle stream over the river toward the light, a wide band of open board between the sage and the light, the lower fifth of the frame plain dark chalkboard

scenes.narration: ఆ కథ సరయూ తీరాన మనువే నిర్మించిన అయోధ్యలో మొదలవుతుంది. అక్కడి రాజు దశరథుడు సత్యవంతుడు, ప్రజలందరికీ ప్రియమైనవాడు.
scenes.visual: ancient Ayodhya on the Sarayu river in morning light, carved stone gateways and stepped shikhara towers across the right two thirds of the frame, tall slender poles on the tower tops with saffron flags flying against open dark board, open board all around each flag, a broad royal road strewn with flowers leading in from the left, the river flowing along the lower middle, horizon line one third from the top, the lower fifth of the frame plain dark chalkboard

scenes.narration: కానీ ఆ మహారాజుకు వంశాన్ని నిలిపే కొడుకు లేడు. కొడుకు లేని జీవితంలో సంతోషమే లేదని ఆయన బాధపడ్డారు.
scenes.visual: a pillared palace hall at night, {dasharatha} with exactly two arms seated on a carved throne at the left third of the frame in three-quarter view facing right, chin lowered in sorrow, his right hand resting open on his knee, his left forearm resting on the armrest, his crown and shoulders against open dark board with the pillars far away at the edges of the hall, a tall standing brass oil lamp with a single flame on open board at the right third, open board all around the flame, a small empty cradle draped in white cloth faint in the shadows at the far right, horizon line one third from the top, the lower fifth of the frame plain dark chalkboard

scenes.narration: అందుకే ఆయన అశ్వమేధ యాగం సంకల్పించారు. వసిష్ఠుడు మొదలైన పురోహితులు ఆశీర్వదించగా, యువముని ఋష్యశృంగుడు యాగం నడిపించారు.
scenes.visual: a sacrificial ground on the bank of the Sarayu river, {vasishtha} with exactly two arms standing at the left third of the frame in three-quarter view facing right, his right hand raised in blessing, held clear of his beard and body against open board, {rishyashringa} with exactly two arms standing at the right third in side view facing left, holding a long ladle out over a square red-brick fire altar, the flames rising on open board, a wide gap of open board between the two sages, a white horse with royal ornaments grazing small far in the background, the river along the horizon, horizon line one third from the top, the lower fifth of the frame plain dark chalkboard

scenes.narration: పుత్రుల కోసం ఋష్యశృంగుడు మరో యజ్ఞం చేస్తుండగా, దేవతలు బ్రహ్మతో మొరపెట్టుకున్నారు: వరగర్వంతో రావణుడు ముల్లోకాలనూ పీడిస్తున్నాడు, సూర్యుడు సైతం అతనికి జంకుతాడు.
scenes.visual: a wide split sky, at the lower left {rishyashringa} with exactly two arms seated in side view facing right, pouring an offering from a ladle into a blazing altar fire with open board around the flames, above the fire in the sky {devas_light} gathered in a loose arc around {brahma_light}, far on the right {ravana_shadow} rising over the walls of a fortress city on a rocky island across a dark sea, a small dim sun above it, wide bands of open board between the fire, the lights and the shadow, horizon line one third from the top, the lower fifth of the frame plain dark chalkboard

scenes.narration: దేవదానవుల నుంచి రక్షణ కోరిన రావణుడు, గర్వంతో మనుషులను లెక్కచేయలేదు. అందుకే విష్ణువు దశరథుడి కొడుకుగా, మానవుడిగా పుట్టడానికి అంగీకరించారు.
scenes.visual: a wide night sky, a great column of soft golden light descending from the upper left toward a small ancient Indian palace of Ayodhya with stepped shikhara towers at the right third, a faint golden conch and discus emblem glowing at the head of the column of light, open board all around the light, the palace windows glowing with warm lamplight, far beyond on the right horizon a small faint crowned shadow, horizon line one third from the top, the lower fifth of the frame plain dark chalkboard

scenes.narration: అప్పుడు అగ్ని నుంచి సూర్యుడిలా వెలిగే ఒక తేజోమూర్తి, దివ్య పాయసంతో నిండిన బంగారు పాత్రతో లేచి వచ్చారు. దీన్ని రాణులకు ఇవ్వండి, కొడుకులు పుడతారు అన్నారు.
scenes.visual: a square red-brick altar at the left third of the frame with a blazing fire, rising from its flames {fire_being} in three-quarter view facing right, holding out a round golden vessel in both hands at arm's length, clear of its body against open board, {dasharatha} with exactly two arms standing at the right third in side view facing left, both arms raised forward with open palms to receive the vessel, his hands held clear of his robes, a wide gap of open board between the vessel and the king's hands, horizon line one third from the top, the lower fifth of the frame plain dark chalkboard

scenes.narration: నిధి దొరికిన పేదవాడిలా పొంగిపోయిన రాజు, సగం కౌసల్యకు, మిగిలినదాంట్లో సగం సుమిత్రకు, ఆపై సగం కైకేయికి ఇచ్చి, కాసేపు ఆలోచించి చివరిది మళ్లీ సుమిత్రకే ఇచ్చారు.
scenes.visual: the verse written in chalk on the open dark board, wide horizontal layout

scenes.narration: చైత్ర మాసం నవమి నాడు కౌసల్యకు రాముడు పుట్టాడు. కైకేయికి భరతుడు, సుమిత్రకు లక్ష్మణ శత్రుఘ్నులు పుట్టారు. అయోధ్య ఆటపాటలతో మారుమోగింది.
scenes.visual: a palace courtyard at festival time, {kausalya} with exactly two arms standing at the left third of the frame in three-quarter view facing right, gazing down tenderly at a cradle draped in white cloth, further right {kaikeyi} with exactly two arms beside one cradle and {sumitra} with exactly two arms beside two cradles, the three queens and the four cradles standing well apart with open board between them, flower petals falling across the open board above, small musicians with a drum far in the background, horizon line one third from the top, the lower fifth of the frame plain dark chalkboard

scenes.narration: నలుగురు రాకుమారులూ విద్యలో, విలువిద్యలో ఆరితేరారు. లక్ష్మణుడు రాముడికి మరో ప్రాణం, అతను లేనిదే రాముడు నిద్రించేవాడు కాదు. రాజు వారి పెళ్లిళ్ల గురించి ఆలోచిస్తుండగానే, ఊహించని ఒక అతిథి ద్వారం దగ్గరకు రాబోతున్నారు.
scenes.visual: an open field at the forest edge in late afternoon, {rama_teen} with exactly two arms riding a horse at a walk from left to right at the left third of the frame, the horse in side view and Rama in three-quarter back view with his face turned away and hidden from the viewer, {lakshmana_teen} with exactly two arms walking a few paces behind him on the left in side view, his bow held clear of his body, a gap of open board between the brothers, a line of trees along the far right, horizon line one third from the top, the lower fifth of the frame plain dark chalkboard

scenes.narration: ఆ అతిథి మరెవరో కాదు, విశ్వామిత్ర మహర్షి. దశరథుడు ఆనందంగా ఎదురెళ్లి, ఏది అడిగినా ఇస్తానని మాట ఇచ్చారు.
scenes.visual: a carved stone palace gateway with pillars and a stepped stone tower on the right side of the frame, a saffron flag flying from a slender pole on top of the tower against open board, {vishvamitra} with dark hair streaked with grey tied in a topknot, a dark beard and a red tilak on his forehead, exactly two arms standing at the left third in side view facing right, his wooden staff planted upright in his right hand, clear of his body, {dasharatha} with exactly two arms hurrying out of the gateway toward him in three-quarter view facing left, palms joined in front of his chest and held clear of his body, his crown and shoulders against open board in front of the gateway, a wide gap of open board between the sage and the king, horizon line one third from the top, the lower fifth of the frame plain dark chalkboard

scenes.narration: నా వ్రతానికి మారీచ సుబాహులనే రాక్షసులు మాంసం, రక్తం కురిపించి భంగం కలిగిస్తున్నారు. వ్రతంలో శపించకూడదు, అందుకే పది రాత్రులు రాముడిని నాకు ఇవ్వు అన్నారు మహర్షి.
scenes.visual: a pillared palace hall, {vishvamitra} with dark hair streaked with grey tied in a topknot, a dark beard and a red tilak on his forehead, exactly two arms standing at the left third of the frame in three-quarter view facing right, speaking, his right hand raised beside his shoulder with the palm outward, held clear of his beard and body against open board, his staff planted upright in his left hand, on the open board at the right a faint chalk memory of a small forest altar inside a soft cloud-shaped vignette, streaks of dark red rain falling only onto its stones, the pillars far at the edges of the hall, horizon line one third from the top, the lower fifth of the frame plain dark chalkboard

scenes.narration: రాజు స్పృహ తప్పి పడిపోయారు. తేరుకున్నాక, నా కమలనయనుడు రాముడికి పదహారేళ్లు కూడా నిండలేదు, రాక్షసులతో పోరాడే వయసు కాదు అన్నారు.
scenes.visual: the verse written in chalk on the open dark board, wide horizontal layout

scenes.narration: నా సైన్యాన్ని తీసుకెళ్లండి, నన్నే తీసుకెళ్లండి, రాముడు లేక క్షణం బతకలేను అని వేడుకున్నారు. ఈ రాక్షసుల వెనుక రావణుడు ఉన్నాడని విని ఆయన భయం రెట్టింపైంది.
scenes.visual: a pillared palace hall, {dasharatha} with exactly two arms half risen from his throne at the right third of the frame in three-quarter view facing left, both arms reaching forward in a pleading gesture with open palms, his forearms and hands held clear of his robes and the throne against open board, {vishvamitra} with dark hair streaked with grey tied in a topknot, a dark beard and a red tilak on his forehead, exactly two arms standing still at the left third in side view facing right, his staff planted upright, a wide gap of open board between them, far away on the open board high in the middle a small faint {ravana_shadow}, the pillars at the edges of the hall, horizon line one third from the top, the lower fifth of the frame plain dark chalkboard

scenes.narration: నెయ్యి పోసిన అగ్నిలా విశ్వామిత్రుడి కోపం భగ్గుమనగా, రఘువంశపు రాజు మాట తప్పడమా అని ఆయన అనగానే భూమి అంతా కంపించింది.
scenes.visual: a pillared palace hall, {vishvamitra} with dark hair streaked with grey tied in a topknot, a dark beard and a red tilak on his forehead, exactly two arms at the left third of the frame in side view facing right, turning away in anger, his staff swung forward in his right hand and held clear of his body, his long matted hair flying out behind him against open board, saffron chalk flames rising from the floor in a wide circle around him with open board between the flames and his body, jagged cracks running across the stone floor toward a throne at the right third where {dasharatha} with exactly two arms sits small, recoiling, the pillars far at the edges, horizon line one third from the top, the lower fifth of the frame plain dark chalkboard

scenes.narration: గురువు వసిష్ఠుడు రాజుకు ధైర్యం చెప్పారు. ధర్మాన్ని విడవకు, అగ్ని కాపాడే అమృతంలా ఈ మహర్షి రక్షణలో రాముడు క్షేమంగా ఉంటాడు అన్నారు.
scenes.visual: a pillared palace hall, {vasishtha} with exactly two arms standing at the right third of the frame in three-quarter view facing left, his left hand resting gently on the shoulder of {dasharatha} with exactly two arms seated on a throne beside him, Vasishtha's right hand raised in counsel, held clear of his beard and body against open board, the king lifting his head toward the guru, open board across the left side, horizon line one third from the top, the lower fifth of the frame plain dark chalkboard

scenes.narration: తల్లి ఆశీస్సులతో, దశరథుడు కొడుకు శిరస్సును ఆఘ్రాణించి మహర్షికి అప్పగించారు. మెల్లగా గాలి వీచింది, ఆకాశం నుంచి పూలవాన కురిసింది, అన్న వెనుకే లక్ష్మణుడు నడిచాడు.
scenes.visual: wide palace steps in morning light, {dasharatha} with exactly two arms at the left third of the frame in three-quarter view facing right, bending his head forward to kiss the top of the head of {rama_teen} with exactly two arms, who stands before him in three-quarter back view with his face turned away and hidden from the viewer with his head bowed, the king's hands resting on Rama's shoulders, {kausalya} with exactly two arms standing a step behind on the far left with palms joined, held a little away from her chest, at the right third {lakshmana_teen} with exactly two arms and {vishvamitra} with dark hair streaked with grey tied in a topknot, a dark beard and a red tilak on his forehead, exactly two arms waiting side by side with a gap between them, a wide band of open board between the family and the two waiting figures, flowers drifting down across the open board above, horizon line one third from the top, the lower fifth of the frame plain dark chalkboard

scenes.narration: సరయూ ఒడ్డున మహర్షి రాముడికి బల, అతిబల అనే మంత్రాలు ఉపదేశించారు, వాటితో అలసట, ఆకలి దరిచేరవు. ఆ రాత్రి అన్నదమ్ములు గడ్డి పరుపుల మీద నిద్రించారు.
scenes.visual: a riverbank at dusk, {vishvamitra} with dark hair streaked with grey tied in a topknot, a dark beard and a red tilak on his forehead, exactly two arms standing at the left third of the frame in side view facing right, his right hand raised over the cupped hands of {rama_teen} with exactly two arms, who kneels before him in three-quarter back view with his face turned away and hidden from the viewer, holding water cupped in both hands held out clear of his body, a gap of open board between the sage's raised hand and Rama's hands, {lakshmana_teen} with exactly two arms kneeling at the right third, well apart, spreading a bed of grass, the Sarayu river flowing across the middle of the frame, the first stars above, horizon line one third from the top, the lower fifth of the frame plain dark chalkboard

scenes.narration: తెల్లవారుతుండగా మహర్షి లేపారు: కౌసల్యకు సుపుత్రుడివి రామా, తొలిసంధ్య వచ్చింది, లే నరశార్దూలా. పదిహేనో శతాబ్దపు శ్రీ వేంకటేశ్వర సుప్రభాతం ఈ మాటలతోనే మొదలై, ఈనాటికీ తిరుమలలో వినిపిస్తుంది. ఆ ఉదయమే వారు గంగ వైపు సాగారు, ఆవల భయంకరమైన అడవి ఉంది.
scenes.visual: the verse written in chalk on the open dark board, wide horizontal layout
scenes.quote_src: VR 1.23.1–2, 1.23.5, 1.24.12–28 (vulgate); Venkatesha Suprabhatam opening (later tradition, Wikipedia 'Suprabhatam', accessed 2026-11-18)

scenes.narration: గంగ దాటాక, ఒకప్పుడు మలద, కరూష దేశాలు ఉన్న ఆ నేలను వెయ్యి ఏనుగుల బలం ఉన్న తాటక అనే యక్షిణి పాడుచేసిందని మహర్షి చెప్పారు.
scenes.visual: a wide river crossing, a small wooden boat at the left third of the frame carrying {vishvamitra} with dark hair streaked with grey tied in a topknot, a dark beard and a red tilak on his forehead, exactly two arms, {rama_teen} with exactly two arms in three-quarter back view with his face turned away and hidden from the viewer and {lakshmana_teen} with exactly two arms seated well apart along its length, waves curling around the hull, on the far right bank a dark tangled forest of broken trees with the distant shadow {tataka} looming between them, her wild hair streaming out on open board, a wide stretch of open water between the boat and the far bank, horizon line one third from the top, the lower fifth of the frame plain dark chalkboard

scenes.narration: ఒక యక్షిణికి ఇంత బలం ఎలా అని రాముడు అడిగితే, అది బ్రహ్మ వరం అన్నారు మహర్షి. కొడుకు మారీచుడితో కలిసి అగస్త్యుడిపై దాడి చేసినందుకు, ఆయన శాపంతో ఆమె రాక్షసిగా మారింది.
scenes.visual: a forest clearing at dusk, {agastya} with exactly two arms standing at the left third of the frame in side view facing right, his kamandalu held out in his left hand clear of his body, his right hand raised palm outward in a curse with a soft glow around the palm against open board, at the right {tataka} and the smaller {maricha} recoiling, standing well apart from each other, a wide band of open board between the sage and the two shadows, trees at the far edges, horizon line one third from the top, the lower fifth of the frame plain dark chalkboard

scenes.narration: స్త్రీ అని వెనుకాడకు, ప్రజలను కాపాడేవాడు పని క్రూరంగా కనిపించినా చేయక తప్పదు, పాలించేవారికి అదే శాశ్వత ధర్మం అన్నారు మహర్షి.
scenes.visual: the verse written in chalk on the open dark board, wide horizontal layout

scenes.narration: రాముడు ధనుష్టంకారం చేయగానే తాటక దూసుకొచ్చింది. అప్పుడు కూడా ఆమెను చంపాలని లేదు, అడ్డుకుంటే చాలు అని లక్ష్మణుడితో అన్నాడు.
scenes.visual: a dark forest at twilight, {rama_teen} with exactly two arms at the left third of the frame in three-quarter back view with his face turned away and hidden from the viewer, facing right, his bow held out at arm's length in his left hand, his right hand drawn back plucking the bowstring, the right elbow raised clear of his body and hair against open board, {lakshmana_teen} with exactly two arms a step behind him on the far left, his bow held clear of his body, the huge shadow {tataka} rushing in from the right between bending trees, both arms stretched forward, her hair streaming back on open board, a wide band of open board between Rama's bow and Tataka, horizon line one third from the top, the lower fifth of the frame plain dark chalkboard

scenes.narration: కానీ ఆమె దుమ్ము రేపి, రాళ్ల వాన కురిపించి, మాయతో మాయమైంది. చాలు ఈ జాలి రామా, సంధ్య వస్తోంది, అప్పుడు రాక్షసులను గెలవలేం అని మహర్షి హెచ్చరించారు.
scenes.visual: a forest clearing in a whirling storm of dust, rocks falling from a dark sky on the right, the shadow {tataka} fading into the haze, {rama_teen} with exactly two arms at the left third of the frame in three-quarter back view with his face turned away and hidden from the viewer, raising one forearm to shield his face, the arm held clear of his bow, {vishvamitra} with dark hair streaked with grey tied in a topknot, a dark beard and a red tilak on his forehead, exactly two arms a few paces behind him on the far left in side view, calling out, his right arm raised high and clear of his body against open board, horizon line one third from the top, the lower fifth of the frame plain dark chalkboard

scenes.narration: శబ్దాన్ని బట్టి గురి చూసి రాముడు బాణాలతో రాళ్ల వానను అడ్డుకున్నాడు, ఆమె మీదకు దూసుకురాగానే ఒకే బాణం వదిలాడు, తాటక నేలకూలింది. దేవతలు పొగిడారు, శాపం పట్టిన అడవి మళ్లీ పచ్చగా విరిసింది.
scenes.visual: a forest at sunset after the storm, {rama_teen} with exactly two arms at the left third of the frame in three-quarter back view with his face turned away and hidden from the viewer, facing right, his bow lowered in his left hand, a fading line of golden light from his arrow vanishing into settling dust on the right, the clearing beyond calm and empty, fresh flowers and green leaves returning on the bushes, a few birds flying back across the open sky, horizon line one third from the top, the lower fifth of the frame plain dark chalkboard

scenes.narration: మర్నాడు మహర్షి చిరునవ్వుతో కాలచక్రం, వజ్రం, బ్రహ్మాస్త్రం, అగ్ని, వాయువు, నిద్రాస్త్రం సహా అస్త్రాలన్నీ రాముడికి ఇచ్చారు. అవి చేతులు జోడించి, మేము నీ సేవకులం అన్నాయి.
scenes.visual: a forest clearing at sunrise, {vishvamitra} with dark hair streaked with grey tied in a topknot, a dark beard and a red tilak on his forehead, exactly two arms seated cross-legged at the left third of the frame in three-quarter view facing right, smiling, his right hand raised in blessing, held clear of his beard and body against open board, his staff lying on the ground in front of him, {rama_teen} with exactly two arms kneeling a little to his right, facing him in three-quarter back view with his face turned away and hidden from the viewer, across the right two thirds a row of four {astra_devas} standing well apart with open board between each figure, palms joined at the chest, heads slightly bowed, above each figure a floating chalk emblem: a golden discus, a vajra thunderbolt, a flame and a swirl of wind, soft morning rays, horizon line one third from the top, the lower fifth of the frame plain dark chalkboard

scenes.narration: రాముడు వాటిని తాకి, నా మనసులో ఉండండి అన్నాడు. ఇక దేవతలు కూడా నన్ను జయించలేరు, కానీ వీటిని వెనక్కి ఎలా రప్పించాలి అని అడిగాడు. మహర్షి అదీ నేర్పించారు.
scenes.visual: the verse written in chalk on the open dark board, wide horizontal layout

scenes.narration: చివరికి కొండ పక్కన మేఘంలా కనిపించే సిద్ధాశ్రమానికి చేరారు. ఇక్కడే రాక్షసులు యాగాన్ని పాడుచేస్తారు, నరశార్దూలా, ఇక్కడే వారిని సంహరించు అన్నారు మహర్షి.
scenes.visual: a peaceful hermitage grove at the right third of the frame beneath a tall mountain, thatched huts among trees and a square red-brick altar with a thin line of smoke rising on open board, {vishvamitra} with dark hair streaked with grey tied in a topknot, a dark beard and a red tilak on his forehead, exactly two arms at the left third in side view facing right, pointing toward the grove with his staff held out at arm's length, clear of his body, {rama_teen} with exactly two arms and {lakshmana_teen} with exactly two arms a few paces behind him on the far left, Rama in three-quarter back view with his face turned away and hidden from the viewer, the brothers well apart, horizon line one third from the top, the lower fifth of the frame plain dark chalkboard

scenes.narration: ఆ రోజే విశ్వామిత్రుడు మౌనవ్రతం పూనారు. మునుల కోరికపై, ఆరు రాత్రింబవళ్లు నిద్ర లేకుండా రామలక్ష్మణులు ఆయన పక్కనే కాపు కాశారు.
scenes.visual: a hermitage at dusk, a square red-brick fire altar in the centre of the frame with steady flames on open board, {vishvamitra} with dark hair streaked with grey tied in a topknot, a dark beard and a red tilak on his forehead, exactly two arms seated cross-legged before it at the left third in three-quarter view facing right, eyes closed in a vow of silence, hands resting on his knees, {rama_teen} with exactly two arms standing guard at the far left in three-quarter back view with his face turned away and hidden from the viewer, facing the forest, {lakshmana_teen} with exactly two arms standing guard at the right third in side view facing right, both bows held clear of their bodies, {ashram_sages} small far behind the altar, the first stars appearing, horizon line one third from the top, the lower fifth of the frame plain dark chalkboard

scenes.narration: ఆరో రోజు, సిద్ధంగా ఉండు అని రాముడు లక్ష్మణుడితో అంటుండగానే, వేదిక మీద అగ్ని భగ్గుమంది, ఆకాశం భయంకరంగా గర్జించింది.
scenes.visual: a hermitage altar under gathering dark clouds, a square red-brick altar at the right third of the frame with its fire suddenly flaring tall, saffron and gold flames leaping on open board, {ashram_sages} small around the altar stepping back, {rama_teen} with exactly two arms at the left third in three-quarter back view with his face turned away and hidden from the viewer, turning toward {lakshmana_teen} with exactly two arms, who stands a few paces away on the far left in side view facing right, Rama's right hand raised beside his shoulder and held clear of his body and bow, his bow in his left hand, dark clouds low across the top of the frame, horizon line one third from the top, the lower fifth of the frame plain dark chalkboard

scenes.narration: వానమబ్బుల్లా రాక్షసులు కమ్ముకొచ్చారు. మారీచ సుబాహులు వేదిక మీద రక్తధారలు కురిపించారు.
scenes.visual: a wide sky over the hermitage, the shadow silhouettes {maricha} on the left and {subahu} on the right, well apart, diving out of churning dark monsoon clouds, streaks of dark red rain falling only onto a square red-brick altar below, {rama_teen} with exactly two arms small in the lower centre in three-quarter back view with his face turned away and hidden from the viewer, running forward, his bow in hand, horizon line one third from the top, the lower fifth of the frame plain dark chalkboard

scenes.narration: రాముడు మెరిసే మానవాస్త్రాన్ని సంధించి మారీచుడి గుండెపై వదిలాడు. అది అతన్ని నూరు యోజనాల దూరాన సముద్రంలోకి విసిరేసింది.
scenes.visual: a hill at the edge of the hermitage with the distant ocean on the horizon, {rama_teen} with exactly two arms drawn large at the left third of the frame in three-quarter back view with his face turned away and hidden from the viewer, facing right, his bow held out in his left hand just after the release, his right hand flung back open after the shot, the right elbow clear of his body and hair against open board, a long streak of white light flying across open board to the right, far away over the ocean at the right third the small shadow {maricha} tumbling head over heels along a low arc of white chalk motion lines toward the horizon, tall rolling waves, horizon line one third from the top, the lower fifth of the frame plain dark chalkboard

scenes.narration: చూడు లక్ష్మణా, ఈ చల్లని మానవాస్త్రం అతన్ని మూర్ఛపరిచి తీసుకుపోయింది, కానీ ప్రాణం తీయలేదు అన్నాడు రాముడు.
scenes.visual: the verse written in chalk on the open dark board, wide horizontal layout

scenes.narration: తర్వాత ఆగ్నేయాస్త్రంతో సుబాహుడిని నేలకూల్చాడు, వాయవ్యాస్త్రంతో మిగిలినవారిని తుడిచిపెట్టాడు.
scenes.visual: a hermitage sky, {rama_teen} with exactly two arms at the left third of the frame in three-quarter back view with his face turned away and hidden from the viewer, his bow raised just after the shot, a blazing chalk arrow wreathed in saffron flames flying across open board toward a tall column of drifting dark smoke on the right where the broad shadow {subahu} is falling away toward the earth, farther right a swirling spiral of white chalk wind sweeping tiny dark shadows into the clouds like dry leaves, horizon line one third from the top, the lower fifth of the frame plain dark chalkboard

scenes.narration: యాగం పూర్తయింది. నా పని నెరవేరింది, సిద్ధాశ్రమం పేరును నువ్వు సార్థకం చేశావు అన్నారు విశ్వామిత్రుడు.
scenes.visual: a calm dawn at the hermitage, a square red-brick altar in the centre of the frame with a small steady flame on open board, {vishvamitra} with dark hair streaked with grey tied in a topknot, a dark beard and a red tilak on his forehead, exactly two arms standing at the right third in three-quarter view facing left, his right hand resting gently on the head of {rama_teen} with exactly two arms, who bows before him in three-quarter back view with his face turned away and hidden from the viewer, {lakshmana_teen} with exactly two arms standing a little apart on the left with palms joined, held a little away from his chest, {ashram_sages} far behind raising their hands in praise, a few birds flying across the open sky, horizon line one third from the top, the lower fifth of the frame plain dark chalkboard

scenes.narration: అలా, చిన్నవాడని తండ్రి భయపడిన ఆ రాకుమారుడు గురువుల మాట నిలబెట్టాడు. ఆరు రోజులు నిద్ర మాని యజ్ఞాగ్నిని కాపాడాడు, యుద్ధంలోనూ ఒకరి ప్రాణం తీయకుండా వదిలాడు.
scenes.visual: a quiet misty morning, {rama_teen} with exactly two arms sitting on a rock at the left third of the frame in three-quarter back view with his face turned away and hidden from the viewer, facing right, his bow laid flat across his knees, looking out over the misty forest toward the open board on the right, {lakshmana_teen} with exactly two arms standing a little apart on the far left, his bow held clear of his body, horizon line one third from the top, the lower fifth of the frame plain dark chalkboard

scenes.narration: మర్నాడు ఉదయం, విశ్వామిత్రుడిని ముందుంచుకుని మునులు మిథిలలో జనకుడి యజ్ఞం గురించి చెప్పారు. దేవాసురులు, రాక్షసులు ఎవరూ ఎక్కుపెట్టలేని ఒక అద్భుతమైన విల్లు అక్కడ ఉంది, ఇక మనుషుల మాటే లేదు.
scenes.visual: the verse written in chalk on the open dark board, wide horizontal layout

scenes.narration: ఎందరో రాజులు ప్రయత్నించి ఓడిపోయారు. ఆశ్రమపు జింకలూ పక్షులూ కొంత దూరం వెంట రాగా, విశ్వామిత్రుడు ఉత్తరంగా, ఆ విల్లు ఎదురుచూస్తున్న మిథిల వైపు బయలుదేరారు.
scenes.visual: a road at sunrise heading north, {vishvamitra} with dark hair streaked with grey tied in a topknot, a dark beard and a red tilak on his forehead, exactly two arms walking from left to right at the right third of the frame in side view, his staff held clear of his body, {rama_teen} with exactly two arms and {lakshmana_teen} with exactly two arms following a few paces behind on the left, well apart, Rama in three-quarter back view with his face turned away and hidden from the viewer, a few deer and birds following on open board at the far left, far on the right horizon a small ancient Indian city of Mithila with stepped shikhara towers and a long golden bow resting on a stone platform, glowing faintly, horizon line one third from the top, the lower fifth of the frame plain dark chalkboard

scenes.narration: బాలకాండలో మొదటి భాగం ఇక్కడ విశ్రమిస్తుంది. యజ్ఞాగ్ని ప్రశాంతంగా వెలుగుతోంది, మిథిలకు దారి తెరుచుకుంది, రాముడి కథ ముందుకు సాగుతుంది.
scenes.visual: calm wide end board at night, a square red-brick hermitage altar at the left third of the frame with a low gentle fire, open board all around the flame, a long empty road winding away from it under a quiet starry sky, the whole right half and the lower part of the frame left as plain open dark chalkboard for end-screen elements, horizon line one third from the top

description: రామాయణం, సుద్దముక్కతో చెప్పిన మహాకావ్యం. ఈ దీర్ఘ భాగంలో: ఒక మహర్షి శోకం తొలి శ్లోకంగా ఎలా మారిందో, సంతానం లేని రాజు నలుగురు రాకుమారులకు ఎలా తండ్రయ్యాడో, పదహారేళ్లు నిండని రాముడు ఆరు రోజులు నిద్ర మాని యాగాన్ని ఎలా కాపాడాడో చూడండి. ఆధారం: వాల్మీకి రామాయణం, బాలకాండ, సర్గలు 1 నుంచి 31 (వల్గేట్ పాఠం).

blessings of mother, father and Vasishtha; the king kisses Rama's head; gentle wind and flowers; order of the walk; Bala and Atibala on the south bank of the Sarayu (no fatigue, fever, hunger, thirst; not overpowered asleep); night on grass beds

learnings.how: Partly applied. The stake is in the first line (a boy his father feared was too young, and the rakshasas coming); the cold open closes in about thirty-two seconds. The 35 s beat shape is Shorts-only.

Applied in its long-form form: the first Telugu line is written natively short (two short sentences, estimated 5.6 s, under the 6 s long-form warning), not translated from the English hook. Frame 0 is the shared guarded-fire image.
Not applied in narration (long-form has no engagement line). Pinned-comment suggestion for the packager: తొలి శ్లోకానికి కారణమైన పక్షి ఏది? (answer in the text: క్రౌంచ పక్షి, VR 1.2.10–15).
